name: cfg
about: The config write path. `#lfc=cfg.<nonce>.<encoded json>` answers `ok.<nonce>` / `err.<nonce>` under its own name, so a cfg request and a cfg reply have nearly the same shape — which is why classifyLfc needs a dedicated arm for it.

steps.note: a bare nonce and no json
an empty bindings object must answer ok, not err
unparseable json answers err rather than throwing
